is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii collected in Bandundu City, DRC (page 4, 'Laboratory analyses'; page 16, Table 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for kdr-West (L1014F), kdr-East (L1014S), and ace-1 (G119S); reports genotype counts and frequencies for L1014F and L1014S in Table 5 (page 4 and page 16).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 (page 16) provides sample sizes (n) and exact RR, RS, and SS genotype counts along with allele frequencies for L1014F and L1014S in An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii before and after ITN distribution.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes collected in Bandundu City, Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of Congo (page 3, 'Study site' and 'Mosquito collection').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research study reporting original entomological, bioassay, and molecular data collected from July 2015 to June 2016.

sub_country_location.evidence: Bandundu City (3.3168° S, 17.3790° E; -3.335123, 17.378747), Kwilu Province, DRC (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections occurred between July 2015 and June 2016; Table 5 specifies exact timepoints: October 2015 and June 2016.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study was conducted by local university/INRB researchers with technical assistance from CDC Atlanta; there is no indication that these genotype data overlap with existing large consortium releases.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are fully presented in Table 4 and Table 5 in the main manuscript text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector transmission metrics, WHO insecticide resistance (deltamethrin, permethrin, DDT, and bendiocarb with/without PBO synergist), and target-site resistance markers (Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii before and after a mass ITN distribution campaign in Bandundu City, DRC. Complete RR, RS, and SS genotype counts for L1014F and L1014S are tabulated.
